name: Theme Builder
description: Live theme editor for the Jellyfin web client: colours, cards, details pages, player, presets and more.
overview: Adds a Theme Editor to the user menu with a live preview. The theme applies to every web client and is copied into Custom CSS for TV apps.

versions.changelog: Registers with File Transformation 3.x reliably: when Jellyfin has it loaded more than once at startup, Theme Builder registers with every copy that accepts instead of retrying the first one found, so the Theme Editor and script features load again.
